repositories.reason: Strong lifecycle and claim-audit patterns, but non-commercial licensing and broad overlap prohibit public code/content fusion.
Language, figure, and review contracts overlap P5-P9; retain upstream as a versioned knowledge source.
Best current source for narrow scientific database/package adapters; stage individual Skills only when the detected domain requires them.
Review and recovery patterns are useful, but its autonomous orchestration, artifact conventions, and higher-effort defaults overlap canonical owners.
Use narrow framework skills for in-depth AI engineering; do not import its autoresearch orchestrator or duplicate RAG stack.
Claim-evidence and reverse-outline behaviors overlap the paper audit and venue-grounded writing owners.
Motivation-contribution spine and revision-matrix ideas are useful, but the full end-to-end orchestrator would duplicate three owners.
No repository license; retain URL and high-level discovery only, with no content copied into the public package.
Adopt bounded rollout-reflect-edit-validate acceptance and rejected-edit memory; do not require its external model stack at runtime.
Separate extraction from consumption and evaluate the actual target agent/harness because useful extraction can still cause negative transfer.
Compare no-Skill, single-Skill, and multi-Skill conditions with task-level verifiers; keep its large benchmark payload external to the compact plugin.
Use its repository and retrieval perspective as composition context, while retaining exact artifact bindings and local evidence gates.
Motivates measuring multi-Skill behavior on the actual target; no reported result is transferred to an untested local composition.
Composition is relevant, but no redistributable repository license was verified; preserve only the URL, immutable commit, and high-level comparison.
Use workflow-localized transfer as a scoped nearby-task hypothesis; require a target-cell matrix and never extrapolate its reported transfer to untested models, harnesses, or tasks.
Retain a persistent parent-linked hypothesis and artifact/evidence tree; reject its separate agent executor because Research Guard already owns execution and resources.
Use its threat model to test instruction injection and authorization context; never import attack payloads into admitted Skills or treat static filtering as sufficient.
Reusable API synthesis is academically relevant, but automatic executable program generation crosses the quarantine, authorization, and canonical-executor boundaries.
Useful graph-RAG architecture, but indexing cost and prompt/model requirements exceed the compact provenance graph needed here.
Feature-rich external backend; not admitted because the present graph needs deterministic metadata retrieval without an LLM service.
Strong local full-text scientific RAG with citations; keep optional because default models and embeddings require provider configuration.
Perspective-guided question decomposition is useful for ideation, but report generation overlaps writing and is not publication-ready by its own documentation.
Externally validated active-learning screening is a real gap for systematic reviews; install only when that workflow is requested.
Its systematic-review Skill is discoverable, but the full harness duplicates execution, memory, subagents, and sandbox ownership.
Use when exact venue CSL style output is requested; do not vendor the large style collection into the compact plugin.
Permissively licensed CSL-capable formatter for exact styles beyond the compact built-in four; keep optional because DOI verification and claim support remain separate gates.
Full CSL rendering is preferable for publication output, but copyleft boundaries mean it is not copied into this package.
